notes: Download-only base: the clean zip is 73 MB, far too large to commit (the other base zips here are 0.7-6.8 MB). apply_overlay supports this for upstreams with stable per-version archive paths. If Nanomani ever prunes old versions the overlay is still trivially re-derivable: it is a single-line DELETION, described in full below. base_zip_local points at a gitignored copy: present on a dev box for fast rebuilds, absent in CI where it falls through to base_zip_url.
changelog:
0.0.6 - Let the skin's own setup wizard run again.
We had been pre-seeding 189 skin settings, including startup.init, which
is the flag the skin's first-run block is gated on. That suppressed the
block, and Home.xml sets FullInitEnded=1 on first load which is what the
setup wizard's visibility is gated on -- so a new install came up fully
configured and never offered setup. Exactly backwards from what Asaf
asked for.
Now we ship NO skin settings. Our functional defaults (the gates that hide
the ratings row, and clearlogo instead of title -- 21 settings) are applied
ONCE from Home.xml, gated on Skin.HasSetting(startup.init) so they land
AFTER the skin's own first-run, plus our own kodirdil.defaults marker so
they never re-apply. The user keeps ownership afterwards: turning ratings
back off now sticks. Nothing cosmetic is touched. The font stays forced on
every load, deliberately -- every other fontset is tofu in Hebrew.

0.0.5 - Ship the Hebrew translation. Upstream ships 52 of 639 strings
translated (8%), so the skin's settings were almost entirely English on a
Hebrew build. Now 638/639 (the one left is a whitespace spacer).
Sources, in order: the 52 upstream already had, kept verbatim; 67 reused
from our Zephyr he_il where the English msgid is identical, so shared
terminology stays consistent; the remaining 519 newly written.
Checked: 0 markup/tag mismatches against the msgids ([B], [CR], [COLOR],
$INFO/$VAR/$LOCALIZE all preserved), and 0 Latin-LEADING strings -- nine
were rewritten (HUB סרטים -> מרכז סרטים, EPG במסך מלא -> לוח שידורים
במסך מלא, ...) because a Latin run at the head of a Hebrew line gets
reordered and reads backwards. View-type names deliberately keep the
English in parentheses at the END, per Asaf, so they stay recognisable.

0.0.4 - Fix the RTL separator collapse across the skin (466 sites, 16
files). Neutrals between a European Number and a Hebrew run resolve to R
(UAX#9), so `  •  ` was absorbed into the Hebrew run and re-ordered to its
far end: the year fused with the genre and both separators piled up
(2026פשע / ... • • 27m). Replaced with LRM + NBSP around the bullet; LRM is
strong LTR so the run binds to the paragraph instead. An earlier attempt
used RLM, which forces the very absorption being prevented.
These 16 files are GENERATED - never hand-edit them. Re-run
tools/gen_rounded_bidi_overlay.py after bumping base_version; it starts
from clean upstream, or from our overlay file where we carry other edits
(Home.xml: buildxml fix + font pin; Includes_OSD.xml: the GearsAI wand).

0.0.3 - Add the GearsAI subtitles ("Wand") button to the player OSD.
Rounded was the only skin in the build with no reference to
service.subtitles.gearsai at all. Added as a button in the OSD subtitles
submenu (id 9326), same RunScript(...,sub_window) call Zephyr uses, hidden
when the addon is absent or on LiveTV / music videos.

0.0.2 - Pin the skin font to NotoSans Regular (settingskinfont=11).
It is the only one of the skin's eleven fontsets containing a Hebrew face;
the skin's setup wizard lets the user choose a font and runs AFTER anything
we seed into addon_data, so seeding could not hold it. Re-asserted on every
Home load, which fires as soon as the setup wizard closes. Only the font is
forced; every other setup choice stays the user's.

0.0.1 - Initial overlay. Removes ONE line from 1080i/Home.xml:
    <onload>RunScript(script.skinshortcuts,type=buildxml)</onload>
Home.xml calls buildxml TWICE on load: line 12 with the real parameters (mainmenuID=300, group=mainmenu|x1111..x1119|powermenu|searchmenulist, levels=10) and line 13 with none, which defaults to levels=0. The two race; whichever finishes last wins. When the bare one won it overwrote the full 324 KB includes with a 20 KB level-0-only file containing no skinshortcuts-template-widgets and no -1 submenu groups, so EVERY widget row silently failed to load and kodi.log said 'Skin has invalid include: skinshortcuts-template-widgets'.
Measured 2026-08-29: with the line present the result alternates between 324334 and 20154 bytes across boots; with it removed, three consecutive boots with the hash cleared all produced 324334.
This is an upstream bug (the line is present in clean 1.3.00) and should be reported to Nanomani so the overlay can be dropped.
